Re-based on 2026-11-20 at 1,297,311 B measured after the third batch of ten rebuilt style pages and its review fixes (cap was 1,300,000 B), the same way as before: measured total plus less than the largest chunk (the entry, 157,996 B). Earlier: Re-based on 2026-11-19 at 1,162,819 B measured across all lazy routes; 1,186,401 B after merging the 2026-11-10 content corrections. The first cap (1,150,000 B) was the 2026-09-22 measurement of 944,130 B plus about 22%. Rebuilt style pages carry real copy and their prompt in three languages; each adds 6 to 12 KB gzip to its own lazy chunk, which loads only on that page, so the sum grows with every rebuilt page. The cap exists to catch an accidental corpus or a duplicated large module: the largest single chunk, the entry, is 157,051 B, so a second copy of it still exceeds 1,300,000 B. Initial-load cost is guarded separately by entryJsGzipBytes and the per-route closures. Re-base the same way (measured total plus less than the largest chunk) when reviewed page rebuilds move the total.
